en: A monochrome printed postcard showing a three‑story masonry building identified as the Masonic Temple in Lewiston, Idaho. The structure has arched entrances at street level, upper-story windows, and a balcony. A sign reading "THEATRE" stands on the left, and large trees line the street. Handwritten notes appear at the top and lower right of the image. Printed caption text in red at the bottom credits Henry Fair of Lewiston, Idaho, with a 1905 copyright.
